title: Gibson Agent Manifest
description: Schema for agent.gibson.zeroroot.ai/v1 agent manifests. Use a YAML editor with yaml-language-server support to get autocomplete: # yaml-language-server: $schema=schema.json

kind.description: Must be 'Agent'. Maps to gibson.identity.v1.PrincipalKind.PRINCIPAL_KIND_AGENT. Sister schemas exist for 'Plugin' and 'Tool' manifests.

name.description: DNS-label-style identifier for the agent. Must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9]$.

version.description: Semantic version of the agent (e.g. '1.2.3' or '0.1.0-alpha').

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the agent.

author.description: Optional identifier for the agent's author.

llm_slots.description: Named LLM slots the agent will resolve at runtime via slot_resolver. Each slot is bound by tenant policy to a concrete provider/model.

tool_dependencies.description: Tools the agent intends to call. Each entry is a tool component name (without 'tool:' prefix).

plugin_dependencies.description: Plugins the agent intends to query. Each entry is a plugin component name (without 'plugin:' prefix).

MemoryDecl.description: Optional memory permissions the agent declares it needs. The daemon gates per-namespace access at FGA Check time.

namespaces.description: Memory namespaces the agent intends to read or write.

startup_timeout.description: Maximum duration before the startup probe fails. Go duration string (e.g. '30s'). Defaults to '30s'.

liveness_interval.description: Interval at which the liveness probe is polled. Go duration string (e.g. '10s'). Defaults to '10s'.
